# Slid Phi Labs
> Lossless-compression and agent-infrastructure lab in Cherry Hill. Public proof, private performance, paid production.
> https://www.slidphilabs.com/

## Who
Slid Phi Labs. Corey Tasz. Human door: /humans  Agent door: /agents  Inbox: corey@slidphilabs.com

## Products
Five cards. Not a SKU dump.
- AWARE — hosted lossless compressor (files). $9/day · $49/mo · $490/yr. Access, not source. Meter: Suite 6.9 GB / 3 h then ~5¢/GB. https://www.slidphilabs.com/gc
- TRUSTREAM — live 4 KiB residual pipe (streams). STORE + ZERO. Agent logs / SIEM. Not a zstd replacement. Runs on an AWARE seat. https://www.slidphilabs.com/trustream
- Chamber — two-key JSON seal. $9/mo · $99/yr. Open existing seals with both keys. https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber
- Agent-Rider — signed agent identity L0–L4. $79/mo · $790/yr. https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider
- CuNi — one source → Python, Go, JS or refuse. $0. https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni
PCC is the house frame (ZERO / MATCH / BWT / STORE), not a SKU. Combined GC is the private engine. pulsar is the public GPLv3 demo: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pulsar


## Checkout
Humans: POST /api/checkout { "sku": "chamber-year", "rail": "stripe" } → Stripe card session.
UI: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay
Try: https://www.slidphilabs.com/box
